using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 2;
const ll LINF = LLONG_MAX / 3;
const double DINF = DBL_MAX / 3;
const ll MOD = 998244353;
const double EPS = 1e-10;
const double PI = acos(-1.0);

vector<ll> fact;
vector<ll> revFact;

ll mul(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = (x * y) % MOD;
    return res < 0 ? res + MOD : res;
}

ll pow_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (y % 2 == 1) return (x * pow_mod(x, y - 1)) % MOD;
    ll root = pow_mod(x, y / 2);
    return (root * root) % MOD;
}

ll div_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = x * pow_mod(y, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    return res < 0 ? res + MOD : res;
}

void preFact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    revFact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = mul(i + 1, fact[i]);
    }
    revFact[n] = div_mod(1, fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = mul(revFact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

ll cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    if (fact.empty()) {
        cerr << "error : factorials has not been culculated!! do [pre_factorial] method" << endl;
    }
    ll af = fact[a];
    ll bf = revFact[b];
    ll abf = revFact[a - b];
    ll res = mul(mul(af, bf), abf);
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    ll tmp;
    cin >> n >> tmp;
    
    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return;
    }
    
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    ll ans = 0;
    int si = 1;
    ll t = cmb(n, n - k);
    
    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        ans += si * cmb(n - k, i) * pow_mod(i, n);
        ans %= MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        si *= -1;
    }
    
    ans *= t; ans %= MOD;
    if (k != 0) ans *= 2; ans %= MOD;
    if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
    
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    solve();
    
    return 0;
}
